GgDashboardPanel.description: One panel of a [dashboard](GgDashboard): a heading, a query, and how wide it sits.

query.description:
The panel's query, as TCQ **source text**. A copy, even when the panel was
built from a saved query — see the module docs.

width.description:
How many of the [twelve](DASHBOARD_COLUMNS) grid columns the panel spans,
clamped to `1..=12`.

description: An operator's saved dashboard: panels of TCQ over one board-level range.

description.description: A one-line note on what the board is for. Empty when unset.

id.description: The dashboard's opaque id (minted on create).

panels.description: The board's panels, in render order, at most [`MAX_DASHBOARD_PANELS`].

rangeId.description:
The board-level time range, as the picker's token. **One per board** — a panel
never gets its own.

updatedAt.description: RFC 3339 of when the dashboard was last saved.

title: GgDashboard
